blind.description: A sculpted decorative altar piece or statuette representing a Green Man or forest deity. It features an integrated faceted plinth base decorated with foliate trim and a central roundel, supporting a relief carving of a bearded face emerging from oak-like leaves, flanked by side leaves and crowned by small deer antlers. Materials appear to be patinated bronze or carved painted stone in mossy green, antique gold/bronze, and tan-brown antler tones.
blind.from_above: A winged leafy crest tapering back from the front face, showing the pointed tips of the leaves and antlers resting on an angled, faceted plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-fourth to one-fifth the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 ft wide.
